run.command: strata bench run --url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --out /home/<user>/bench/results/2026-10-20-standard-rtx-3090-strata-2.1-220232 --track custom --track-notes Strata 2.1 stack, engine binary from the 2.1 release (0.1.46 per release notes; the server self-reports its version string as 0.1.45, known labeling bug). Launch: ~/bin/strata-2-q6-bmo with strata-swift-q6-final7.json: resident-budget 100 GiB, expert-cache auto + expert profile, spec 4 + MTP, kv int8, conversation-cache 12288 MiB / 2 slots / min 4096 tokens, pipeline-windows 2, vram-reserve 896/1024, prefill auto:16384, spec-min-p 0.70, adapt every 1 / swaps 80 / decay 0.97, pcie-frac 0; env STRATA_MMQ_KQ, STRATA_PREFILL_HELP, STRATA_EXCHANGE_ROTATE, STRATA_PROMPT_ATTN_IMMA, STRATA_ATTN_DAILY, STRATA_QSA_SPLIT_ATTN all 1; pack packs/swift-q6; 2x RTX 3090 layer split
